name: exploded
description: A drone that comes apart in your hands: each part on its own rail, numbered and measured, drawn round in ink; it flies only when whole. Drop in any GLB. three.js.
author: Oliver Kure Olsen (https://work.draindk.tech)

scripts.build: esbuild demo/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=docs && cp demo/index.html demo/public/* docs/ && mkdir -p docs/draco && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/draco_decoder.wasm node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/draco_wasm_wrapper.js docs/draco/
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes serve docs
